guides.label_zh: 寻找 AI 软件作品
guides.title_en: AI-built software: examples and development evidence
guides.title_zh: AI 软件作品：从案例找到开发证据
guides.description_en: Find games, websites and native apps with first-party AI-development statements, then distinguish code, demos and limited interaction evidence.
guides.description_zh: 从游戏、网站和原生应用中寻找有作者 AI 开发说明的作品，区分源码、演示与有限操作证据。
guides.answer_en: Start with the artifact and its creator’s development account. A public demo shows an available interface; source code shows an implementation; neither alone proves who wrote it. The projects below have explicit author evidence, with the contribution scope and practical limits preserved.
guides.answer_zh: 先找具体作品，再看创作者的开发记录。公开演示能展示界面，源码能展示实现，两者都不能单独证明开发方式。下列项目均有明确作者证据，并保留 AI 参与范围及实际限制。

questions.question_en: Does “AI-built” mean every asset and dependency was generated?
questions.question_zh: AI 构建是否代表所有素材和依赖都由 AI 生成？
questions.answer_en: No. Read the attributed contribution scope. A generated interface can use a human-written library; a generated game can contain human-made models, music and an original game design.
questions.answer_zh: 不是。应查看作者声明的具体范围。生成界面可能使用人工编写的库，生成游戏也可能包含人工模型、音乐和原创设计。

questions.question_en: Where can I find more examples for a particular platform?
questions.question_zh: 如何找到某个平台的更多作品？
questions.answer_en: Use the app-platform indexes and select Software made with AI. The broader category also contains environment and dataset resources, whose platform tags have a different meaning.
questions.answer_zh: 进入应用平台索引并选择“AI 软件作品”。较大的分类还包含环境和数据集，这些条目的平台标签含义不同。

questions.question_en: Which examples have actual interaction notes?
questions.question_zh: 哪些案例有实际操作记录？
questions.answer_en: Tic Tac Toe, Aldi Prices, CSV To Charts and Markdown → Slides have dated steps and screenshots for specific browser interactions. Each record separates visible outcomes from untested features; these are not full application certifications.
questions.answer_zh: 井字棋、Aldi Prices、CSV To Charts 和 Markdown → Slides 记录了特定浏览器交互的日期、步骤与截图。各记录区分可见结果与未测试功能，不构成完整应用认证。

groups.intro_en: Compare an original demo, a reconstruction and a work with human-produced assets. Their creation claims cover different components.
groups.intro_zh: 对照原创演示、重建作品及使用人工素材的作品，留意各自开发声明覆盖的组件。

choices.fit_en: Inspect a published generating prompt, single-file game and one recorded two-player round.
choices.fit_zh: 查看公开生成提示、单文件游戏及一局双人操作记录。

choices.fit_en: Study an AI-assisted browser port while preserving the original game’s authorship and separate data rights.
choices.fit_zh: 研究 AI 辅助浏览器移植，同时保留原游戏作者及独立素材权利。

choices.fit_en: See how generated implementation can work with an artist’s scans, animation and sound.
choices.fit_zh: 了解生成实现如何结合作者的扫描、动画及声音素材。

groups.intro_en: These examples connect a concrete use to a traceable maker account. A hosted interface does not establish backend correctness or a reuse license.
groups.intro_zh: 这些案例将具体用途与可追溯的作者说明关联；托管界面不代表后端正确或已授予复用许可。

choices.fit_en: Inspect a data-driven site and the separately recorded search-to-history interaction.
choices.fit_zh: 查看数据网站及独立记录的搜索到历史页面流程。

choices.fit_en: Follow an openly documented implementation history for an image-cropping browser tool.
choices.fit_zh: 追溯图片裁切工具公开记录的实现过程。

choices.fit_en: Inspect a file-to-chart demo with separately recorded sample-chart controls; imported files and PNG output remain unverified.
choices.fit_zh: 查看文件转图表演示及独立记录的样例图表操作；文件导入与 PNG 输出仍未验证。

choices.fit_en: Inspect a typed-Markdown preview with a recorded two-slide navigation check; it has no built-in file export.
choices.fit_zh: 查看输入 Markdown 的预览工具及两页翻页记录；该工具没有内置文件导出。

groups.intro_en: Check the application’s actual distribution target. A browser client, a native bundle and a command-line layer have different installation and provenance boundaries.
groups.intro_zh: 检查应用实际分发目标；浏览器客户端、原生安装包和命令行封装的安装与开发来源边界不同。

choices.fit_en: Inspect a native macOS MCP client with creator development evidence and published code.
choices.fit_zh: 查看有作者开发证据和公开源码的原生 macOS MCP 客户端。

choices.fit_en: Inspect a native Mac interface that manages Linux containers; the target and managed runtime differ.
choices.fit_zh: 查看管理 Linux 容器的原生 Mac 界面，区分应用平台与被管理的运行环境。

choices.fit_en: Compare a packaged Windows application with a public release history but proprietary source.
choices.fit_zh: 对照有公开版本历史、但源码专有的打包 Windows 应用。

choices.fit_en: Examine an AI-generated Windows CLI layer around a separately authored library.
choices.fit_zh: 研究围绕独立人工库构建的 AI 生成 Windows 命令行层。

choices.fit_en: Inspect an Android terminal application with a documented prerelease distribution.
choices.fit_zh: 查看有预发布分发说明的 Android 终端应用。

groups.intro_en: These alpha applications have creator-reported LLM assistance, public source and desktop release artifacts. Artifact availability does not establish professional file fidelity or runtime stability.
groups.intro_zh: 这些 Alpha 应用有作者自述的 LLM 辅助开发证据、公开源码和桌面安装包。产物可下载并不代表专业文件兼容性或运行稳定性已经验证。

choices.fit_en: Inspect layered image editing with explicitly documented PSD and workflow limits.
choices.fit_zh: 查看分层图像编辑实现及明确记录的 PSD 和工作流限制。

choices.fit_en: Study vector editing and cross-format exchange with incomplete Illustrator and Affinity compatibility.
choices.fit_zh: 研究矢量编辑及格式交换，留意尚不完整的 Illustrator 和 Affinity 兼容性。

choices.fit_en: Inspect a native video-editor implementation and its stated alpha-stage workflow gaps.
choices.fit_zh: 查看原生视频编辑器实现及其公开说明的 Alpha 阶段工作流缺口。

guides.title_en: Browser agent benchmarks: controlled sites, live tasks and recorded data
guides.title_zh: 浏览器 Agent 评测：可控网站、在线任务与记录数据
guides.description_en: Compare browser-agent resources by interaction setting, scoring and setup: self-hosted sites, live-web evaluation, recorded trajectories and shared frameworks.
guides.description_zh: 按交互方式、评分及配置比较浏览器 Agent 资料：自行部署网站、真实网页评测、记录轨迹和统一框架。
guides.answer_en: Choose the evaluation setting before choosing a benchmark. Controlled sites let you reset task state; live-web tasks expose changing content and dependencies; recorded trajectories test predictions without an open-ended browser run. A shared framework can connect these resources without making their scores interchangeable.
guides.answer_zh: 先决定评测设置，再选择基准。可控网站支持重置任务状态，真实网页任务会受到内容和外部依赖变化影响，记录轨迹则在没有开放式浏览器执行的情况下测试预测能力。统一框架能连接这些资料，但不会让分数天然可比。

questions.question_en: Can a screenshot or recorded action benchmark prove end-to-end task completion?
questions.question_zh: 截图或记录动作基准能证明完整任务完成吗？
questions.answer_en: No. Target localization and action prediction measure components. End-to-end completion needs an executed trajectory and the benchmark’s outcome check or stated judging procedure.
questions.answer_zh: 不能。目标定位和动作预测衡量局部能力，完整任务完成需要实际执行轨迹，并使用基准的结果检查或明确评分流程。

questions.question_en: What should an evaluation report preserve?
questions.question_zh: 评测报告应保留哪些条件？
questions.answer_en: Record the benchmark revision, task split, browser observation/action interface, reset procedure, model and tool access, judge configuration and run date. Changing these can change what the score measures.
questions.answer_zh: 记录基准版本、任务划分、浏览器观察与动作接口、重置步骤、模型和工具权限、评审配置及运行日期；这些条件变化会改变分数含义。

questions.question_en: Is BrowserGym itself another independent task set?
questions.question_zh: BrowserGym 本身是另一套独立任务吗？
questions.answer_en: It is a framework integrating multiple resources. Each benchmark retains its own setup and access requirements. Do not add framework integrations to the underlying task counts as new independent projects.
questions.answer_zh: 它是集成多种资料的框架，各基准保留自己的配置与访问要求，不能把框架集成数量再当作独立项目叠加到原始任务数中。

groups.intro_en: Choose these when resettable state and a specified task outcome are central to the experiment. Hosting and approved instance access are part of the setup.
groups.intro_zh: 当可重置状态及明确任务结果是实验核心时，从此类资料开始；托管与实例访问许可也是配置的一部分。

choices.fit_en: Isolate short web-control skills in synthetic tasks.
choices.fit_zh: 在合成任务中单独研究短程网页控制能力。

choices.fit_en: Evaluate multi-step work on self-hosted sites with outcome checks.
choices.fit_zh: 在自行部署的网站上通过结果检查评估多步操作。

choices.fit_en: Use the separately maintained evaluator and trace artifacts for the same WebArena task family; do not add its task counts to the original.
choices.fit_zh: 使用单独维护的评分器及轨迹产物评估同一 WebArena 任务族；不要与原始任务数相加。

choices.fit_en: Add image-dependent reasoning to controlled website tasks.
choices.fit_zh: 在可控网站任务中加入依赖图像的推理。

choices.fit_en: Study enterprise workflows when the required ServiceNow access is available.
choices.fit_zh: 在具备所需 ServiceNow 访问权限时研究企业流程。

groups.intro_en: These settings exercise current external websites. Preserve dates and judge details; changes outside the agent can affect a run.
groups.intro_zh: 此类设置使用当时的外部网站。需保留日期与评审细节，Agent 之外的变化也会影响执行。

choices.fit_en: Study multimodal browsing trajectories with an automated visual judge.
choices.fit_zh: 研究使用自动视觉评审的多模态浏览轨迹。

choices.fit_en: Evaluate current-site task completion with recorded action and screenshot evidence.
choices.fit_zh: 结合动作及截图证据评估真实网站上的任务完成。

choices.fit_en: Study live workflows with request and trajectory evidence; task-specific interception does not block every external action.
choices.fit_zh: 结合请求和轨迹证据研究在线流程；任务级拦截不会阻止所有外部操作。

choices.fit_en: Evaluate long-horizon search and cited answers with judge agents; the full task/evaluator distribution is gated.
choices.fit_zh: 用评审 Agent 评估长流程搜索及带引用回答；完整任务和评分器分发有访问门槛。

choices.fit_en: Find versioned live-site instructions while supplying your own agent, authorized accounts and outcome assessment.
choices.fit_zh: 查找有版本记录的在线网站指令，并自行准备 Agent、获准使用的账号及结果评估。

groups.intro_en: Use these for action prediction, instruction following or component studies. They are not substitutes for running an agent freely on a live website.
groups.intro_zh: 适用于动作预测、指令跟随或组件研究，不能替代 Agent 在真实网站上的自由执行。

choices.fit_en: Study generalization across held-out tasks, sites and domains using recorded actions.
choices.fit_zh: 通过记录动作研究跨任务、网站和领域的泛化。

choices.fit_en: Study multi-turn browsing instructions and demonstrated actions.
choices.fit_zh: 研究多轮浏览指令及演示动作。

groups.intro_en: A common interface can reduce integration work while leaving each benchmark’s environment and scoring assumptions intact.
groups.intro_zh: 统一接口可以减少集成工作，但仍应保留各基准的环境及评分假设。

choices.fit_en: Connect supported web benchmarks to a common research interface.
choices.fit_zh: 将支持的网页基准接入统一研究接口。

guides.title_en: Computer-use and mobile-agent benchmarks: environments versus datasets
guides.title_zh: 电脑与手机 Agent 评测：交互环境与静态数据
guides.description_en: Choose desktop VMs, Android/iOS research apps or static GUI datasets while keeping target OS, host requirements, scoring and access limits separate.
guides.description_zh: 比较桌面虚拟机、Android/iOS 研究应用及静态 GUI 数据集，区分目标系统、宿主要求、评分和访问限制。
guides.answer_en: Match the resource to the capability you need to measure. Whole-workflow evaluation needs an executable desktop or phone environment and a defined outcome. Grounding and action-program datasets isolate components. The host running an emulator is not necessarily the operating system an agent is being evaluated on.
guides.answer_zh: 按需要测量的能力选择资料。完整流程评测需要可执行的桌面或手机环境及明确结果；定位和动作程序数据集用于单独研究组件。运行模拟器的宿主系统，不一定是 Agent 任务所针对的操作系统。

questions.question_en: Does running a benchmark on a Mac make it a macOS benchmark?
questions.question_zh: 在 Mac 上运行基准，就代表评测 macOS 吗？
questions.answer_en: No. A Mac may host an Android emulator or another OS image. Read the target applications and task environment separately from host architecture, virtualization and driver requirements.
questions.answer_zh: 不是。Mac 可能承载 Android 模拟器或其他系统镜像。应将目标应用及任务环境，与宿主架构、虚拟化和驱动要求分别检查。

questions.question_en: Can I compare static grounding accuracy with task success?
questions.question_zh: 静态定位准确率能和任务成功率直接比较吗？
questions.answer_en: They measure different units. A correctly localized control may still be followed by an incorrect action or plan. Compare the same task unit, inputs and evaluation protocol, and report component and workflow results separately.
questions.answer_zh: 两者的测量单位不同。控件定位正确后仍可能出现错误动作或计划。比较时应统一任务单位、输入和评测协议，并分别报告组件与完整流程结果。

questions.question_en: Are research app replicas the original commercial services?
questions.question_zh: 研究应用仿真就是原商业服务吗？
questions.answer_en: No. Seeded or simulated apps provide controlled workflows and data. Their results should not be reported as demonstrated success on the named production services without separate evidence.
questions.answer_zh: 不是。预置或模拟应用提供可控流程和数据，未经独立证明，不能把实验结果描述为在相应生产服务上完成任务。

groups.intro_en: Start with the target OS and available virtualization. Check task revisions, application licensing and whether resets restore the state needed by the evaluator.
groups.intro_zh: 先看目标系统与可用虚拟化条件，再确认任务版本、应用许可，以及重置是否恢复评分器需要的状态。

choices.fit_en: Evaluate multi-application desktop workflows with final-state checks.
choices.fit_zh: 通过最终状态检查评估跨应用桌面流程。

choices.fit_en: Study the separate long-horizon Ubuntu-and-web task set, with gated task/assets access and pinned release components.
choices.fit_zh: 研究独立的 Ubuntu 与网页长流程任务集，留意任务／资产访问门槛和固定组件版本。

choices.fit_en: Study Windows GUI workflows on the prescribed VM setup.
choices.fit_zh: 在指定虚拟机配置上研究 Windows GUI 流程。

choices.fit_en: Study native macOS interaction with Apple-hardware and VM requirements.
choices.fit_zh: 在满足 Apple 硬件和虚拟机要求的条件下研究原生 macOS 交互。

groups.intro_en: Read task coverage separately from obtainable VM images. Commercial application licensing and application-specific artifact checks can determine which experiments are possible.
groups.intro_zh: 分别检查任务覆盖和实际可获取的虚拟机镜像。商业软件许可及应用专用产物检查会影响哪些实验可以开展。

choices.fit_en: Study scientific workflows using the public original VM; the newer prebuilt Docker image remains a private review artifact.
choices.fit_zh: 通过公开的原始虚拟机研究科学工作流；较新的预构建 Docker 镜像仍属于私有评审产物。

choices.fit_en: Evaluate GUI-driven FreeCAD work through saved artifacts; CAM tasks need a host FreeCAD console.
choices.fit_zh: 通过保存的产物评估 GUI 驱动的 FreeCAD 操作；CAM 任务需要宿主 FreeCAD 控制台。

choices.fit_en: Explore engineering task definitions while accounting for the narrower set of public Ubuntu software images.
choices.fit_zh: 研究工程任务定义，同时考虑公开 Ubuntu 软件镜像覆盖范围更小。

groups.intro_en: These projects require prepared devices or emulators and particular applications. Keep simulation, real installed apps and scoring methods explicit.
groups.intro_zh: 这些项目需要准备设备或模拟器和特定应用；应明确区分模拟应用、真实安装应用及评分方式。

choices.fit_en: Evaluate repeatable Android workflows with parameterized tasks.
choices.fit_zh: 通过参数化任务评估可重复的 Android 流程。

choices.fit_en: Compare Android agents with the released images and instruction data.
choices.fit_zh: 使用发布的镜像和指令数据比较 Android Agent。

choices.fit_en: Study controlled simulated Android apps and seeded task state.
choices.fit_zh: 研究可控模拟 Android 应用及预置任务状态。

choices.fit_en: Evaluate tasks across seeded research apps in an iOS simulator.
choices.fit_zh: 在 iOS 模拟器中评估预置研究应用的跨应用任务。

choices.fit_en: Study mobile action and trajectory safety detection; APK setup gaps and license conflicts are recorded separately from safety claims.
choices.fit_zh: 研究移动操作和轨迹的安全检测；APK 配置缺口及许可冲突与安全性声明分别记录。

groups.intro_en: Use these when the research question concerns perception or action prediction. Downloading screenshots does not supply the applications or an executable operating system.
groups.intro_zh: 当问题涉及感知或动作预测时使用此类资料；下载截图并不会获得对应应用或可执行操作系统。

choices.fit_en: Measure target localization in high-resolution professional interfaces.
choices.fit_zh: 在高分辨率专业界面中测量目标定位能力。

choices.fit_en: Study screen-and-instruction conversion into action programs.
choices.fit_zh: 研究从屏幕及指令到动作程序的转换。

choices.fit_en: Study recorded Android demonstrations and action prediction.
choices.fit_zh: 研究记录的 Android 演示与动作预测。

guides.title_en: Web and game generation benchmarks: appearance, interaction and execution
guides.title_zh: 网页与游戏生成评测：外观、交互和执行
guides.description_en: Compare webpage reconstruction and game-development benchmarks by supplied inputs, generated artifact, tested behavior and released evaluation materials.
guides.description_zh: 按输入资料、生成产物、测试行为及已发布评测材料，比较网页重建和游戏开发基准。
guides.answer_en: Specify what the generated software must reproduce: a written specification, a screenshot, an interaction trace, a scoped edit or a complete runnable project. These are different targets. Visual similarity does not establish functional equivalence, and a playable game does not automatically demonstrate subjective quality or a general game-playing policy.
guides.answer_zh: 先明确生成软件需要复现什么：文字规格、截图、交互轨迹、局部修改，还是完整可运行项目。这些目标不同。视觉相似不代表功能等价；游戏可玩也不能自动证明主观质量或通用游戏策略。

questions.question_zh: 哪类基准适合截图转代码？
questions.answer_en: Start with a visual reconstruction benchmark such as Design2Code. If the requirement includes state changes or interaction traces, inspect Interaction2Code or IWR-Bench and their exact tested transitions.
questions.answer_zh: 可从 Design2Code 等视觉重建基准开始。如果要求包含状态变化或交互轨迹，应查看 Interaction2Code 或 IWR-Bench 及其具体测试的转换。

questions.question_en: Are game development and game playing the same evaluation?
questions.question_zh: 游戏开发和玩游戏是同一种评测吗？
questions.answer_en: No. Development benchmarks evaluate generated or edited software artifacts. Game-playing environments evaluate an agent’s actions inside a world. Report which side of that boundary the experiment measures.
questions.answer_zh: 不是。开发基准评估生成或修改的软件产物，游戏环境则评估 Agent 在世界中的行动。报告实验时应明确测量的是哪一种能力。

questions.question_en: Does a public paper mean the complete evaluator is available?
questions.question_zh: 论文公开就代表完整评分流程已发布吗？
questions.answer_en: No. Inspect code, task data, assets, access approval and judge configuration separately. Dashboard2Code has gated data; the reviewed GameCode4D release exposes only part of the described engine pipeline.
questions.answer_zh: 不是。需分别检查代码、任务数据、素材、访问审批和评审配置。Dashboard2Code 的数据需申请；已核查的 GameCode4D 发布仅覆盖所描述引擎流程的一部分。

groups.intro_en: Match the input and tested behavior: a written specification, still image, specified state transitions, video trajectory or dashboard exploration. Do not infer backend equivalence from a visual score.
groups.intro_zh: 匹配输入及测试行为：文字规格、静态图像、指定状态转换、视频轨迹或仪表盘探索；不要从视觉分数推断后端等价。

choices.fit_en: Evaluate interactive websites generated from instructions using functional and appearance checks.
choices.fit_zh: 通过功能及外观检查，评估根据指令生成的交互网站。

choices.fit_en: Evaluate visual reconstruction from supplied webpage screenshots.
choices.fit_zh: 评估根据网页截图进行的视觉重建。

choices.fit_en: Evaluate specified interactions as well as visible page states.
choices.fit_zh: 同时评估指定交互与可见页面状态。

choices.fit_en: Reconstruct visible states and interactions demonstrated in a video.
choices.fit_zh: 重建视频演示的可见状态及交互。

choices.fit_en: Inspect dashboard exploration and generation with explicit data-access constraints.
choices.fit_zh: 在明确数据访问限制的前提下研究仪表盘探索与生成。

groups.intro_en: An existing-project edit, a complete game and a generated 3D scene call for different checks. Pin engine and task versions before interpreting comparisons.
groups.intro_zh: 现有项目修改、完整游戏和生成的三维场景需要不同检查；解读比较结果前，应固定引擎及任务版本。

choices.fit_en: Evaluate scoped edits to existing Godot projects.
choices.fit_zh: 评估对已有 Godot 项目的限定范围修改。

choices.fit_en: Evaluate complete 2D Godot games through launched artifacts and replayed input.
choices.fit_zh: 通过启动产物及输入重放评估完整二维 Godot 游戏。

choices.fit_en: Compare Pygame generation using code, screenshots and short recordings.
choices.fit_zh: 结合代码、截图及短时录像比较 Pygame 生成。

choices.fit_en: Inspect game-world prompts and Blender artifacts while tracking missing pipeline components.
choices.fit_zh: 查看游戏世界提示和 Blender 产物，同时保留未发布流程组件的说明。

guides.title_zh: 编程 Agent 的基准与训练环境
guides.description_en: Compare repository repair, application development, terminal tasks and generated training environments by what the agent changes and how outcomes are checked.
guides.description_zh: 按 Agent 修改的对象及结果检查方式，比较代码库修复、应用开发、终端任务和生成式训练环境。
guides.answer_en: First identify the work unit: a repository patch, an application change, a proposal decision or a terminal outcome. Then choose matching tests and environment state. Training-task generation and held-out evaluation serve different purposes, even when both use containers and executable tests.
guides.answer_zh: 先明确任务单位：代码库补丁、应用修改、方案选择，还是终端操作结果，再选择匹配的测试和环境状态。训练任务生成与保留集评测用途不同，即使它们都使用容器及可执行测试。

groups.intro_en: Use a defined issue and test contract. Passing tests establishes only the behavior those tests cover, not every product requirement.
groups.intro_zh: 采用明确的问题描述和测试要求；测试通过只能证明被覆盖的行为，不能证明所有产品要求。

choices.fit_en: Evaluate real repository issue resolution against project tests.
choices.fit_zh: 用项目测试评估真实代码库问题的修复。

groups.intro_en: Keep coding and decision tracks separate. A benchmark targeting Android source code does not measure a phone agent navigating the GUI.
groups.intro_zh: 分别报告编码与决策赛道；面向 Android 源码的基准并不测量手机 Agent 的 GUI 导航能力。

choices.fit_en: Compare application-code fixes and engineering-manager proposal choices as separate tracks.
choices.fit_zh: 分别比较应用代码修复与工程管理者的方案选择。

choices.fit_en: Evaluate Kotlin/Java changes with the public Android Bench 1.0 build-and-test tasks.
choices.fit_zh: 用公开的 Android Bench1.0 构建和测试任务评估 Kotlin／Java 修改。

groups.intro_en: These environments return execution feedback over multiple steps. Pin task images, available commands and the final-state verifier.
groups.intro_zh: 这些环境在多步执行中提供反馈；需固定任务镜像、可用命令及最终状态评分器。

choices.fit_en: Evaluate multi-step command-line outcomes in versioned task environments.
choices.fit_zh: 在带版本的任务环境中评估多步命令行操作结果。

choices.fit_en: Study how an agent reacts to errors and execution feedback in coding tasks.
choices.fit_zh: 研究 Agent 如何利用编码任务中的错误及执行反馈。

groups.intro_en: Use these to collect repair trajectories or construct training tasks. Their size is not a held-out performance score.
groups.intro_zh: 用于收集修复轨迹或构建训练任务；数据规模不等于保留集上的性能成绩。

choices.fit_en: Collect test-verified repair trajectories and train solution verifiers.
choices.fit_zh: 收集经过测试检查的修复轨迹，并训练解法验证器。

choices.fit_en: Synthesize repository repair tasks from test-failing changes.
choices.fit_zh: 基于导致测试失败的修改，合成代码库修复任务。

questions.question_en: Can I add combined and split package counts?
questions.question_zh: 能否将总包与子集的任务数相加？
questions.answer_en: No. SWE-Lancer Diamond combines 198 coding and 265 manager tasks into 463 total tasks. Registry packages for all, IC and manager are views of one family, not three disjoint collections.
questions.answer_zh: 不能。SWE-Lancer Diamond 的198项编码任务和265项管理任务合计463项。注册表的 all、IC 和 manager 包属于同一项目族，不是三个互不重叠的集合。

questions.question_en: Does the latest announcement identify the public runnable release?
questions.question_zh: 最新公告是否就是公开可运行的版本？
questions.answer_en: Check the released artifact. Android Bench publicly links its 1.0 task set, while the 2.0 methodology describes a separate private task set. Keep the accessible dataset, harness and published result version aligned.
questions.answer_zh: 需检查实际产物。Android Bench 公开链接的是1.0任务集，2.0方法说明描述另一个私有任务集。应对齐可访问的数据、框架与已发布结果的版本。

questions.question_en: What changes when a benchmark is adapted to Harbor?
questions.question_zh: 基准适配到 Harbor 后可能改变什么？
questions.answer_en: Packaging can change prompts, visible tests, tools, timeouts and metrics. Preserve the adapter revision and its documented differences. A family association in the upstream index does not prove score equivalence.
questions.answer_zh: 封装可能改变提示、可见测试、工具、超时及指标。应保留适配版本及其明确差异；上游索引的项目关联并不证明分数等价。

guides.title_en: Data-agent benchmarks: databases, notebooks and research workflows
guides.title_zh: 数据 Agent 评测：数据库、笔记本与研究流程
guides.description_en: Compare data engineering, code-executing analysis and ML experiment resources while separating final-answer checks from workflow and environment validation.
guides.description_zh: 比较数据工程、代码执行分析与机器学习实验资料，区分最终答案检查、工作流程验证和环境验证。
guides.answer_en: Choose what a correct result means before choosing the environment. A data-engineering task may check resulting tables, an analysis benchmark may score final answers, and a desktop workflow may inspect application state. These checks expose different failures and should not be combined into an undifferentiated score.
guides.answer_zh: 先定义正确结果，再选择环境。数据工程任务可能检查结果表，分析基准可能只给最终答案评分，桌面流程则可能检查应用状态。这些检查暴露的错误不同，不宜混合成一个不加区分的分数。

groups.intro_en: Separate local database copies from tasks touching real cloud accounts. Match the database version, initialization and exact expected-table or query checks.
groups.intro_zh: 区分本地数据库副本与操作真实云账号的任务；应对齐数据库版本、初始化及具体结果表或查询检查。

choices.fit_en: Evaluate dbt/project changes through database-backed tests and expected outputs.
choices.fit_zh: 通过数据库测试及预期结果评估 dbt／项目修改。

choices.fit_en: Study clarification and SQL execution in an interactive database setting.
choices.fit_zh: 在交互式数据库环境中研究需求澄清及 SQL 执行。

groups.intro_en: An execution environment allows a calculation to be performed; an answer scorer decides whether the reported result matches its reference. Inspect both.
groups.intro_zh: 执行环境让计算得以完成，答案评分器判断报告结果是否匹配参考值；两者都需要检查。

choices.fit_en: Evaluate computational-biology analyses with the released notebook environment and chosen answer grader.
choices.fit_zh: 使用公开笔记本环境及选定答案评分器评估计算生物学分析。

choices.fit_en: Study multi-file business-data reasoning with a public agent baseline and answer-scoring protocol.
choices.fit_zh: 结合公开 Agent 基线和答案评分协议，研究多文件业务数据推理。

groups.title_zh: 电子表格产物与办公工具
groups.intro_en: File correctness and coordinated tool use are different from native GUI navigation. Preserve workbook recalculation, scoring backend and whether email/calendar operations are simulations.
groups.intro_zh: 文件正确性和工具协作不同于原生 GUI 导航。应记录工作簿重算、评分后端，以及邮件和日历操作是否为模拟。

choices.fit_en: Evaluate spreadsheet edits across workbook test cases; Verified is a subset of the original release.
choices.fit_zh: 通过工作簿测试案例评估表格编辑；Verified 是原始发布的子集。

choices.fit_en: Evaluate distinct business spreadsheet workflows; VLM chart grading accepts PNGs directly, while XLSX chart extraction needs Windows Excel/WPS COM.
choices.fit_zh: 评估独立的商业表格工作流；VLM 图表评分可直接接收 PNG，XLSX 图表提取则需要 Windows Excel/WPS COM。

choices.fit_en: Study coordinated structured tools over local documents and simulated email/calendar files, rather than native Office GUI sessions.
choices.fit_zh: 研究本地文档及模拟邮件／日历文件上的结构化工具协作，区别于原生 Office GUI 会话。

groups.title_zh: 桌面流程与机器学习实验
groups.intro_en: These resources include broader application or experiment state. Accounts, compute and task assets can be part of the environment rather than merely input files.
groups.intro_zh: 这些资料涉及更广泛的应用或实验状态；账号、算力与任务资产可能是环境组成部分，而不只是输入文件。

choices.fit_en: Evaluate data workflows that combine graphical tools, code and state checks.
choices.fit_zh: 评估结合图形工具、代码和状态检查的数据流程。

choices.fit_en: Study agents that modify ML methods and run iterative experiments.
choices.fit_zh: 研究修改机器学习方法并进行迭代实验的 Agent。

questions.question_en: Does a split named train establish training permission or evaluation validity?
questions.question_zh: 划分名为 train 是否代表可用于训练或能保证评测有效？
questions.answer_en: The label is not enough. BixBench’s public split is named train but carries a no-training-corpus contamination notice. Preserve author usage guidance and keep it distinct from the declared data license.
questions.answer_zh: 名称并不足够。BixBench 的公开划分叫 train，但含有不得纳入训练语料的防污染声明。应保留作者使用说明，并与数据许可分别记录。

questions.question_en: Are local adapter labels always the official hidden answers?
questions.question_zh: 本地适配器的标签总是官方隐藏答案吗？
questions.answer_en: No. DABstep’s default file omits answers, while six of its questions also appear in the answered dev set. The reviewed Harbor adapter reconstructs labels from scored public submissions; equivalence to official evaluation has not been established.
questions.answer_zh: 不是。DABstep 的 default 文件不提供答案，其中六道题也出现在附答案的 dev 集中。已核查的 Harbor 适配器从已评分公开提交重建标签，尚不能认定与官方评测等价。

questions.question_en: How should I report dataset size?
questions.answer_en: State the unit and version: questions, unique task IDs, capsules, ready task folders or adapter-selected tasks. Development splits can overlap test IDs, and a capsule can contain several questions. Record discrepancies rather than silently summing them.
questions.answer_zh: 注明单位与版本：问题、唯一任务 ID、胶囊、ready 任务目录或适配器选中的任务。开发划分可能与测试 ID 重叠，一个胶囊也可能包含多道问题；应保留差异，避免直接累加。
